Correction: the stats I listed higher up actually apply to the golden version of this helmet (which comes from the treasure hunt theme quest linked beneath it). For the blue/red/silver version...

Florentine Recipe (speak to Metalcaster)
Cost: 200 Casting Contribution Consumption

+1 Reloading
+1 Leadership
5k total fame to equip

Color customizable.
